Introducing Saved Views, available today on all paid plans. Managing a busy board or backlog often means rebuilding the same filters, sorting, and grouping every time you switch context. Saved Views fixes that: set up the filters, sorting, and grouping you want once, save it, and return to that exact setup whenever you need it.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so you can keep separate setups for sprint planning, bug triage, client reporting, or anything else your workflow demands. Need your team to see things the way you do? Views can be shared, so everyone works from the same filtered perspective instead of recreating it themselves. Shared views are especially useful for standups, retros, and status updates, where consistency matters more than customization.

Saved Views works across every list in your workspace and updates live as new items match your criteria, so your view is always current. No setup, no add-ons, no waiting — it's ready in your account right now.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
